final_text: The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`). The bug was that `div0` was being latched from the live `divisor` input instead of the captured `dvs` register, violating the spec's rule that only the operand values at the start edge (E0) should affect the result — `divisor` could change during the 8 busy cycles and corrupt `div0`. Changed it to use `dvs`.
